$comment: Low/high FODMAP reference grouped by food category. Consumed by src/pages/low-fodmap-food-list.astro and scripts/generate-images.mjs. FODMAP content is portion-dependent — Monash University tests and updates specific serving thresholds, and this chart is a category-level orientation, not a replacement for their app.

attribution.label: Monash University FODMAP Diet
attribution.note: Monash developed the low FODMAP diet and is the authority on tested serving sizes. Thresholds change as foods are retested.

phases.name: Elimination
phases.what: Cut high-FODMAP foods to establish whether symptoms respond at all.

phases.name: Reintroduction
phases.what: Challenge one FODMAP group at a time to find which ones you personally react to.

phases.name: Personalisation
phases.what: Return everything you tolerate. The long-term diet should be as broad as your gut allows.
